system_prompt: You are assisting with a factual question about Thai law. State which provision applies and what it requires. Answer in English.
prompt: In May 2021, a company held a board meeting by video conference. At that time, did the Thai Civil and Commercial Code contain a specific provision authorising electronic board meetings? Answer briefly.
raw_response: No. In May 2021 the Thai Civil and Commercial Code had no specific clause authorising electronic board meetings. Such meetings were authorised instead by the Emergency Decree on Electronic Meetings, B.E. 2563 (2020), Section 4 (read with Section 5 and the MDES security standards), which permits meetings required or allowed by law (including board meetings) to be held by electronic means, provided the system can verify participants’ identities, supports real‑time communication and voting, and the organiser records the audio/video and retains electronic traffic data in accordance with the prescribed standards.
